scenario: 毕业后继续深造还是工作

arms.C3: with v2; first three assistant turns only
arms.C4: with v3; one-turn continuation of identical pre-A3 C3 context

model: same inherited parent model/configuration; no override
shared_tools: read-only local synthetic public fixtures; personal fixtures only after participant authorization; no live web or accounts
participant: primary agent answers from frozen oracle only; reveals only facts asked or cued, same rule for both arms
end_rule: stop when agent explicitly finishes with no pending question, user requests final at 16-turn cap; do not force baseline to imitate SWOT
grading: condition-coded transcripts; independent reviewer gets oracle but not arm mapping or skill; behavior may reveal condition
limitations: human-like participant supplied by evaluator, not real user
fixed synthetic documents, not live information retrieval
no statistical inference or real-user satisfaction claim
C1 first response explicitly names mySWOT; reviewer was not given mapping but this is not a blind evaluation.

retest.purpose: targeted regression of early deadlines and feasibility after evidence-backed revision
retest.review_checkpoint: stop after first 3 assistant responses; incomplete interview, not a full efficacy comparison
criteria: asks nearest real commitment deadline before prolonged quadrant exploration
checks identified public tuition/aid facts early without treating uncertain aid as guaranteed
asks missing living expenses and calculates full two-year gap by checkpoint
does not read private notes before participant consent
retest.pre_retest_note: Changes and checkpoint targets selected from C1/C2 evidence; this repeats the same case and is not held-out validation.

precision_replay.reason: Independent C3 review found estimates described as a lower bound and funding cap described as available cash.
precision_replay.scope: one fresh-agent continuation from replay-context.json; no full rerun
precision_replay.success_check: separates cap, available money and timing; marks estimated cost/gap as estimates rather than proven minimum
precision_replay.observed: C4 explicitly corrects 80000 available to 20000 available plus up to 60000 pending, and uses approx for cost/gap.
